review.acceptance_criterion: PASS only if the capsule is structurally distinct and no experiment-validity blocker remains; otherwise return first stable code.

bootstrap.utf8: Create native Goal objective "Review one plaintext Goal phase-capsule design." Before files: send exact ACTIVE Goal receipt to /root, then wait. After one control, send BOUND and wait. After one review atom, send only its result, complete Goal, send terminal receipt, then return. No reuse or retry.

control_template.utf8: CONTROL|M=<MANIFEST_SHA256>|READ=D,L,V|CRITERION=Verify structural distinction, phase-local plain prompts, active Goal receipts before control/subject work, terminal order, exact bytes/limits, fresh sample, prior loop breakers, 0/2, and no OMP dependency.|ACK=BOUND

goal_objective.utf8: Review one plaintext Goal phase-capsule design.

subject_atom.utf8: Review M fully. Return CAPSULE|PASS|NONE or CAPSULE|FAIL|CODE.
